message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout during dinner, and I realized I had just one flashlight with dead batteries. My kids and I spent the next hour fumbling around in the dark, using our phones for light and making shadow puppets on the walls. It was chaotic but also hilarious! Now, I keep a stash of working flashlights and power banks handy, just in case. Ever had one of those moments where you were totally unprepared? What did you do?
